title: Spider tibia
concept: The middle leg segment of a giant spider.
sheet: Studio product photograph of a single long straight tapered cylinder sculpture, 2.6 m long, 0.25 m thick at the left end tapering evenly to 0.12 m at the right end, a ridged collar at the left end, a few short black thorns, smooth satin dark brown-black lacquer with subtle reddish-brown mottling. Side view, lying horizontally, both ends fully in frame. A single object alone, nothing else, generous space around it, plain light grey seamless background, soft even studio light, no floor, no shadows, no text or logos.
